assessment_summary: I validated the Docker Compose deployment of Liquio in /workspace (commit 399b8b1). I confirmed: (1) all 20 containers are Up (healthy) with no unhealthy services; (2) the event service that required recovery is now stable (RestartCount=0, server listening on 7004, healthcheck pings 200); (3) the guide's two documented access points respond — admin panel on :8082 (Liquio Admin, JS bundle served) and cabinet on :8081 (Liquio Cabinet), plus id-front on :8080; (4) all 7 public APIs respond to /test/ping; (5) inter-service communication works via /test/ping/services aggregating pong from 7 downstream services; (6) auth middleware is active (401 on unauthenticated /auth/me); (7) healthchecks are substantive real HTTP/liveness checks defined in the Dockerfiles; (8) the generated CA and user p12 key files (admin.p12/demo.p12) are valid and open with the documented passwords 'admin'/'demo' with correct serials; (9) build.log confirms all 26 images built from source. Limitations: the guide's optional 'Example process' data-import browser exercise was not performed (files present in examples/); the Playwright test suite has no node_modules (installing deps is out of bounds and it's a separate post-setup step); a full browser-based p12 login was not executed (no browser automation, test deps missing) though the x509 path, sign-tool, id-api, and login UI are all verified serving. These are optional post-setup/browser exercises, not required installation steps, so they do not indicate an incomplete installation. Overall the installation is complete and operational per the guide, supporting a SUCCESS outcome.
